component.name: AI Quota
component.summary: Live usage quotas for Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Grok

description.p: A panel widget that reads the usage limits of four AI CLIs already signed in on this machine: Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Grok. It shows the plan, the session and weekly windows, and the credit balance each vendor reports, with no account data sent anywhere but the vendor's own usage endpoint.

ul.li: Bars or wrapping circular gauges, per widget
Refresh on a configurable interval, with a manual refresh
Reads only the credentials the vendor CLIs already wrote, nothing else
Keeps the last good reading for a rate limit or an outage
